dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Nam, your ideas in the debate were good, but they weren't very convincing.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, jʊr aɪˈdiːəz ɪn ðə dɪˈbeɪt wɜːr ˈɡʊd, bʌt ðeɪ ˈwɜːrnt ˈvɛri kənˈvɪnsɪŋ.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: You only gave one point of view. A good speaker talks about other points of view, too.
dialogue.reading: juː ˈoʊnli ˈɡeɪv ˈwʌn ˈpɔɪnt əv ˈvjuː. ə ˈɡʊd ˈspiːkər ˈtɔːks əˈbaʊt ˈʌðər ˈpɔɪnts əv ˈvjuː, ˈtuː.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Use "however." For example: "Free university is expensive. However, it helps poor students."
dialogue.reading: ˈjuːz haʊˈɛvər. fər ɪɡˈzæmpəl: ˈfriː ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsəti ɪz ɪkˈspɛnsɪv. haʊˈɛvər, ɪt ˈhɛlps ˈpʊr ˈstuːdənts.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I see. "Many graduates move abroad. Nevertheless, most of them stay in Thailand."
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈsiː. ˈmɛni ˈɡrædʒuəts ˈmuːv əˈbrɔːd. ˌnɛvərðəˈlɛs, ˈmoʊst əv ðɛm ˈsteɪ ɪn ˈtaɪlænd.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Good. "Nevertheless" is quite formal. In conversation, you can say "even so."
dialogue.reading: ˈɡʊd. ˌnɛvərðəˈlɛs ɪz ˈkwaɪt ˈfɔːrməl. ɪn ˌkɑːnvərˈseɪʃən, juː kən ˈseɪ ˈiːvən ˌsoʊ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: "Some students waste the opportunity. Even so, most of them work hard."
dialogue.reading: sʌm ˈstuːdənts ˈweɪst ði ˌɑːpərˈtuːnəti. ˈiːvən ˌsoʊ, ˈmoʊst əv ðɛm ˈwɜːrk ˈhɑːrd.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Much more convincing! Is there any exception to your idea?
dialogue.reading: ˈmʌtʃ ˈmɔːr kənˈvɪnsɪŋ! ɪz ðɛr ˈɛni ɪkˈsɛpʃən tə jʊr aɪˈdiːə?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. Students from very rich families should pay. They're the exception.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. ˈstuːdənts frəm ˈvɛri ˈrɪtʃ ˈfæməliz ʃʊd ˈpeɪ. ðɛr ði ɪkˈsɛpʃən.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Very good. Now your opinion sounds balanced.
dialogue.reading: ˈvɛri ˈɡʊd. ˈnaʊ jʊr əˈpɪnjən ˈsaʊndz ˈbælənst.
